narrationTexts: I'll start by finding the remaining `db.query` calls.
finalText:
**Migration done.** 12 files moved from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, 36 call sites. All JS files pass `node --check`.

Left alone on purpose:

| Skipped | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) | Header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it. |
| `cache.query` in 22 repo files | Different object. Not part of this API. |

Next: ask the vendor to ship a `db.execute` build, or wrap `adapter.js` locally.
